sentences.text: Jagorina pandora was a flattened, skate-like fish covered in armor made of unfused tubercles.
Fossils of this species consist mainly of bone fragments and an intact skull.
Jagorina pandora is a species of rhenanid placoderm found in Upper Frasnian Germany.
This specimen provides the primary details regarding the skull anatomy of rhenanids.
Jagorina is a member of the class Placodermi, an extinct group of armored fish.
It belongs to the parent group Asterosteidae.
The species is classified within the family Asterosteidae.
Jagorina lived during the Frasnian stage, between 382.31 and 372.15 million years ago.
